# Copilot Instructions

- Read the project vision and architecture before making structural changes.
- Keep domain logic independent from UI, APIs, and persistence.
- Prefer small, explicit, testable modules over clever abstractions.
- Preserve existing conventions and public contracts unless a change is intentional.
- Add or update focused tests for behavioral changes.
- Treat accessibility, error handling, observability, and security as part of the feature.
- Keep documentation current when architecture or workflows change.
